subject: maths
question:
The following pie-chart shows percentage wise distribution of teachers of six different subjects in a school.

Total number of teachers = 1800

The ratio of the number of teachers in Hindi to the number of teachers in English and Mathematics together is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d91dcca992ef98ac2c3e8000c5b4bbeb7ccbd2929f489f0d92a2cdca9fc860ea.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of teachers in Hindi = 12% of 1800

⇒ 12/100 × 1800 = 216

Number of teachers in English and Mathematics together = (18 + 15)% of 1800

⇒ 33/100 × 1800

⇒ 594

Ratio = 216 : 594 = 4 : 11

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
